home.text: Home Services About Contact Welcome to a World Leading Mining, Metal, Electrical and Instrumentation Industry Development Company in South Africa Who We Are We at Nuthill Technologies are a Company that strives to develop, supply and maintain extremely cost effective solutions for the mining, metal, electrical and Instrumentation industries, while adhering to strict quality standards. Our motto " If you cant measure, YOU can't manage" stands true in all our projects. Being a development based company, customization and system integration are some of our key features that ensurers client specific needs. We pride ourselves in world class quality workmanship, skills, knowledge and service delivery. OUR CORE SERVICES We Deliver a World Class Range of Services For the Mining, Metal, Electrical and Instrumentation Industries NutPro M NutProM is a monitoring and control system. It enables the end user to monitor remote equipment and generate SQL reporting in the industrial enviroment. DepthMaster Our DepthMaster system was developed as an extremely cost effective alternative depth indicator for drill rigs in Opencast and Underground Mining Learn More WAGO EQUIPMENT WAGO products support a wide range of industries. There components and systems are trusted worldwide in industrial, automotive, process engineering, building tehnology and many other sophisticated applications. Nut Pro M Nut Pro M is Nuthill Technologies in-house developed industrial cloud service. Nut Pro M is a remote access and data collection solution which enables the costumer to generate effective and efficient reports as well as remote control. Nut Pro M enables the end user to monitor remote equipment and get reporting on equipment on a per second basis 24/7. Nut Pro M will help industrial organisations manage their energy usage that costs them more than they are actualy recieving.
